text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- General Workers' Union describes budget as "positive". The dominant GWU was cautious, however, over a cost of living increase, saying it doubted whether it was enough.

- Chamber of Commerce, commenting on budget presented by Finance Minister Lino Spiteri, says it sees tax rises as eroding potential for family savings. Spiteri announced higher taxes, including those on petrol, car licences, cigarettes and spirits.
- Government has arrangement with local private hospital on heart operations.

- Foreign Minister George Vella in Rome for meeting with Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dino on Malta's relations with the European Union. New Maltese government is against membership of the EU but wants closer relations with it.
